campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: repository cleanup, benchmark completion, modality verification, and close-out
doctrine: This campaign continues the capability freeze enforced by structure: docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan, every commit binds to a plan row through the gate, and the freeze whitelist in internal/plan/campaign_structure_test.go admits only the rows named here, so no new model family, workflow, policy, or optimization mechanism lands while any row is open; the only construction admitted is a fix a drill surfaced, declared under the owner's correct-as-you-go directive, the model regression check the owner ordered on 2026-09-04 (efficient validation against regressions, the model-regression-* rows), and the simplification rows the owner ordered the same day (the simplify-* rows): a simplification row lowers a reviewed ceiling or removes a surface while the regression check and the committed benchmark records hold or improve, so capability improvement by simplification is measured, and a row that lowers a measured capability is refused, not averaged. Owner rules of 2026-09-01/02 govern every row: no task runs for hours unattended -- every evaluate pass carries -budget, models run smallest first with the 27B last, and MATH is excluded from this campaign; a claim-recording run (evaluate -all, benchmark -publish, train) runs only on a clean tree after its code has landed, never inside the gate, whose candidate always reads as dirty; store-reading verifies run under OVERGO_DATA_ROOT; every green output ends with an audit line naming what did NOT run. Lanes report UNAVAILABLE when a device, model, browser, oracle, or toolkit is missing; unavailable is never passing evidence and never a failure of the drill's owner, and a model whose modality has no declared expectation is reported as unverified, not as verified. Rows whose exact invocation depends on execution-time facts (installed model identities, device presence, evidence identities) bind their final verify through plan -setverify before work starts, never through prose. Findings discovered during a row are parked with cmd/finding and scheduled as rows by the close-out item, not absorbed silently. Reports are generated, never hand-written: docs/BENCHMARK.md by cmd/benchmark-report and docs/MEDIA_REPORT.md by cmd/compatibility -update-media, each with a -check that is its row's verify.

items.title: Model regression fingerprints (owner rule 2026-09-04: efficient model validation against regressions, covering time, performance and long context): a Go owner (internal/modelregress, cmd/model-regress) records per servable text model, as committed evidence bound to the model and the code manifest, two shapes: SHORT, one fixed ~160-token prompt with a 64-token greedy continuation (its token ids and the teacher-forced mean nll of that continuation); LONG, a ladder of prompt lengths doubling from 1024 tokens (1024, 2048, 4096, ...) up to the model's declared context length as the committed model-config declaration states it (the 27B's 256k tokens, for example), and further to its declared rope sequence extension (YaRN or the family's declared scaling) when the recipe declares one, each rung with a 256-token greedy generation (token ids, distinct 4-gram ratio, longest repeated span) and a retrieval probe: facts placed at known depths of the prompt that the greedy answer must reproduce, so long-context capability is measured per rung and not only rate; the ladder stops at the deepest rung the device's measured KV capacity and the -budget admit, the deepest rung reached is recorded, and any shortfall against the declaration is reported in the audit line, never as passing; for both shapes the time and performance record: load ms, time to first token p50, prompt tok/s p50, decode tok/s p50, total wall p50 and peak device bytes, each with the run-to-run spread over 3 runs on the short shape and 1 run per rung on the ladder, so the rate and memory curve against context length is itself evidence; and a fixed deterministic sample of suite cases under the raw-completion protocol scored exactly as the capability probe; -check replays every servable model smallest first inside -budget, one model per process, both shapes every time, and refuses a continuation that is not token-identical (printing the first divergent step and the nll delta), a capability sample below its recorded accuracy, a rate below the recorded p50 minus the recorded spread, a time above the recorded p50 plus the recorded spread, or peak device bytes above the recorded value; reuses cmd/benchmark's measurement, internal/sequencescore's teacher-forced scoring, the long-form tool's degeneration measure, the committed model-config declarations for context and sequence extension, the evaluate suites' case sampling and perf-sweep's per-process isolation, no new inference path; a deliberate numerical change re-records the fingerprints in the same commit with every delta quoted in the message, so no regression lands silently and no free tolerance knob exists

items.title: Complete the pinned benchmark set for every text model, all suites except MATH

steps.title: Record MMLU-Pro (12032 cases) for every servable text model under both protocols, smallest first; the 27B runs as its own operator-launched pass with -budget 3h
steps.rationale: MMLU-Pro is the suite the model cards report, so it is the comparison that matters; it is also the largest, and the 27B at about 0.7 s per case needs over two hours. The 27B pass is launched by the owner, never unattended by the loop, and the smaller models complete first.

steps.title: Compare every recorded suite against its declared published references and the local lm-eval oracle runs, extend the reference declarations to every model that has a model card, and regenerate docs/BENCHMARK.md with a per-model comparison section
steps.rationale: A benchmark number without its reference is a bare fact; the references are store declarations with sources and protocols, and the report prints measured beside published with the protocol difference in view. MATH stays excluded and the report says so.

items.title: Verify every registered model's activated modalities against a declared expectation

steps.title: Publish the capability census: every registered model with its activated tasks, evidence tier, staleness, and on-disk presence, as a store record and a generated table
steps.rationale: The catalog holds about 28 models across 9 tasks and the verification matrix names 5; the census is the denominator every following row reports against. A stale activation is listed as stale, never dropped.

steps.title: Replace the non-empty-output smoke oracle with a declared expectation per model: an instruct model gets a chat probe with a substring oracle, a base model a likelihood floor, a domain model its domain probe; a model without a declaration is reported unverified
steps.rationale: The verified-matrix row overclaimed correctness on a liveness check; a fix surfaced by the drill is admitted under the correct-as-you-go directive. The lane's exit code is the verdict and its audit line names every model that ran without an expectation.

steps.title: Verify the chat, embedding, rerank, and vision-language activations (Qwen, gemma-4, MiniCPM, Qwen3-VL, SenseNova) through smoke-lane, cmd/embedding, cmd/rerank, and vqaparity or sensenovaparity with their declared oracles
steps.rationale: These are the largest activation group; each owner already exists and reports UNAVAILABLE when an oracle or fixture is missing. Bind the exact lane sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Verify the image and video generation activations (Krea-2-Turbo, SimpleDiffusion, Wan2.1-T2V, LiveEdit, Un-0 latent video) through the composite generation lane and latentvideo-run against the media verifier fixtures, exporting samples
steps.rationale: The media-gen campaign left measured phases, peaks, and verifier runs; this row re-runs them at the current commit so the media report reflects code that exists. Bind the exact lane sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Verify the speech synthesis (pocket-tts), OCR (Unlimited-OCR, SenseNova infographic), tabular (tabular-train-probe), series forecast, and embodied (Hy-Embodied-RxBrain) activations through their owners, each against a declared oracle or reported unverified
steps.rationale: These activations are the ones the memory notes as stale ('active recipe lacks verified evidence'); the row either verifies them at the current commit or records exactly which oracle is missing as a finding. Bind the exact owner sequence with -setverify when the row starts.

steps.title: Regenerate docs/MEDIA_REPORT.md from the store's verification records and link the benchmark report from it, so one generated document summarizes every model's verified modalities and benchmark rows
steps.rationale: The report is generated by cmd/compatibility -update-media from store activations and verification claims; hand-written summaries are refused. Its check is the verdict that the document matches the store.

items.title: Deliberate failure and recovery drills carried over from phase 1

steps.title: Add the rollout-plan authoring door (recipe rollout-plan: baseline, candidate, admission evidence, cohort evidence, rollback authority) that derives the cohort share and observation contract from the admission evidence, so rollout projection, quarantine re-entry, and live rollback have a committed plan to run against (finding c9c88020)
steps.rationale: Three control-plane owners parse a committed rollout plan and no command authors one; the phase-1 drill stopped on this prerequisite. It is construction admitted under the correct-as-you-go directive because the drill cannot run without it.

steps.title: Exercise circuit-breaker escalation, candidate quarantine and re-entry, rollback to the predecessor recipe, peer timeout and partial response, and workflow restart with persistent obligations
steps.rationale: The control plane's refusal and recovery paths are capability claims like any other; each has an evidence door under cmd/loop and cmd/agent-loop. Bind the drill sequence via -setverify when it starts.

steps.title: Interrupt a gate run against a scratch clone and recover through -recover-preparation, -recover-interrupted, and the watchdog
steps.rationale: The gate is the most state-bearing process in the repository -- plan mutation, commit, and store writes in one transaction -- and its recovery paths deserve the same drill as checkpoints. Bind the scripted drill via -setverify when it starts.

items.title: Prefill-path unification (owner rule 2026-09-04, capability improvement by simplification): mul_mat prefill now has four paths (exact F32 staging with SGEMM, f16 staging with the tensor-core GEMM for quantized and fp8 weights, direct tensor-core for half-precision weights, the span kernels below the column floor); derive one prefill policy from the weight type, the column count and the measured parity bounds already committed, retire the exact F32 staged path and the per-type duplicates it leaves behind, and let the regression ladder show the prompt tok/s curve against context length on every servable model before and after, the curve recorded as evidence and quoted in the commit; a path may be retired only where the f16-staged parity bound already holds, and the fp8 12B's 1646 prompt tok/s against its bf16 twin's 2850 is the gap the unification is measured against

Publish the campaign census evidence, bind it with plan -bind-census, record the final verification matrix and benchmark and media reports at the closing commit, write the owner-facing summary into the commit body, and clear the recorded stop so the plan is empty
steps.rationale: A campaign ends with the plan empty and every claim bound to evidence at one commit; the close-out row is where the loop proves it has nothing left to do.
